title: Missionary Religions
description: One of the most powerful memes in human history - religions that contain exclusive truth and must be shared

coreArchitecture.centralConcept: One's religion contains exclusive truth and path to salvation that must be shared
coreArchitecture.keyNarratives: Stories of prophets, conversion tales, miraculous transformations
coreArchitecture.invariantElements: Divine authority, universal applicability, moral imperative to spread
coreArchitecture.example: Early Christian apostles spreading the gospel, facing persecution, yet converting entire regions

transmissionMechanisms.primaryVectors: Personal testimony, organized preaching, sacred texts, ritualistic practices
transmissionMechanisms.requiredResources: Dedicated evangelists, meeting places, educational materials
transmissionMechanisms.easeOfTransmission: Moderate complexity, but simplified through parables and personal narratives
transmissionMechanisms.example: Mormon missionaries using a structured approach: initial contact, relationship building, staged revelations of doctrine

selectionDefense.environmentalFactors: Thrives during social upheaval, uncertainty, or cultural transitions
selectionDefense.defenseMechanisms: Faith-based epistemology, martyrdom narratives, prophecy fulfillment claims
selectionDefense.competitiveAdvantages: Offers comprehensive worldview, community support, eternal rewards
selectionDefense.example: Early Christianity absorbing pagan holidays while maintaining core doctrine, making transition easier for converts

evolutionPattern.commonMutations: Denominational splits, cultural adaptations, modernization of practices
evolutionPattern.adaptationCapabilities: Incorporation of local customs, translation into new languages and contexts
evolutionPattern.stabilityVolatility: Core salvation narrative remains while practices evolve
evolutionPattern.example: Catholicism maintaining core doctrine while allowing indigenous practices in Latin America

socialNetworkEffects.groupIdentity: Strong in-group bonding through shared beliefs and practices
socialNetworkEffects.statusDynamics: Recognition for bringing new converts, leadership roles for effective evangelists
socialNetworkEffects.example: Megachurches creating complete social ecosystems: schools, dating pools, business networks

emotionalHooks.primaryEmotions: Fear of damnation, joy of salvation, sense of purpose
emotionalHooks.rewardMechanisms: Community acceptance, spiritual experiences, answered prayers
emotionalHooks.motivationStructures: Eternal life, divine approval, cosmic significance
emotionalHooks.example: The intense emotional experience of "being saved" reinforcing belief and motivating evangelism
